2Q and 1H 2026 Results Report

Summary by AI BETAClose X

TBC Bank Group PLC reported strong financial results for the second quarter and first half of 2026, with net profit reaching GEL 386 million in Q2, up 12% year-on-year, and GEL 751 million for the first half, up 13% year-on-year. Total operating income increased by 10% year-on-year to GEL 917 million in Q2, driven by a 13% rise in net interest income, while net interest margin remained stable at 7.1%. Operating expenses grew 12% year-on-year, but the cost-to-income ratio improved to 38.3%. Gross loans increased by 12% year-on-year to GEL 31.3 billion, and customer deposits grew 15% year-on-year to GEL 26.5 billion. The bank also declared a quarterly dividend of GEL 1.75 per share for Q2 2026.
